title: Fabric Data Factory orchestration
summary: Use Fabric pipelines/dataflows to coordinate ingestion and transformations while keeping compute-specific logic in the appropriate engine.

blocks.text: Use Fabric pipelines/dataflows to coordinate ingestion and transformations while keeping compute-specific logic in the appropriate engine.

items: Copy activities move data; notebooks/stored procedures can perform transformations.
Parameterize reusable pipelines and make environment-specific values external.
Track lineage and operational metadata for each run.
Do not hide complex business logic inside orchestration expressions when a tested code/notebook layer is more maintainable.

provenance: Original AtlasNote V3 foundation seed authored for product integration; no third-party text or private data.
